lines.en: “Bookmark number 4.”
[Exclusive skill, ‘Way of the Wind Lv.11(+1)’ has been activated!]
I dodge the poisonous stingers flying at me from the ‘Scorpion Goddess’.
Poison that could vaporize the entire area with a single hit, if the incarnation body's power weren't suppressed. But as long as I had [Way of the Wind], I would be fine.
Hissssss!
I step onto the melted canyon floor and unleash [White Pure Star Energy]. The thick bandages of the ‘Last Pharaoh’ meet the sword's thrust.
Thuuung!
As the bandages and blade collided, a sound like a drum rang out, and my body was thrown back.
King Oedipus's flash cannon shot toward me, seizing the opening.
[Exclusive skill, ‘Beast King’s Sensitivity Lv.10(+1)’ is in use!]
Hissssss!
Normally, this would have been an impossible fight.
After all, I could originally use only one [Bookmark] at a time.
[All your skills have improved through the effect of the Story ‘Looked into the Abyss’!]
[You are currently using 2 Bookmarks simultaneously.]
[Bookmark duration is reduced by half.]
But my skills had improved further across the board since I last checked my Attributes Window.
“Bookmark number 5!”
Whoooosh!
[Exclusive skill, ‘Electrification Lv.12(+2)’ has been activated!]
Having shrunk in an instant through [Miniaturization], I became a point of light and pierced the ‘Last Pharaoh's’ torso.
Gaaaaaaaah!
Mortally wounded, the ‘Last Pharaoh’ screamed and collapsed to the ground.
I was fighting back with the history I had built, layer upon layer.
What I had read.
The time I had lived through.
Those alone were everything I had.
How many more flashes of light had blazed, how much more blood had I shed?
King Oedipus spoke in a tone that sounded slightly weary.
[Impressive, Demon King of Salvation.]
[To be honest, I did not expect you to have grown this strong.]
But there was no hint of defeat on his face.
Shadows began gathering above the canyon, one by one.
They were the other constellations affiliated with [Melledon] and [Bercan].
[Duke Bercan]
[Mysterious Bird of the Nile]
[Supreme God of Light]
Even a rough count put the number of constellations that had appeared at nearly ten.
Constellations looking down at me from the high ridge of the canyon.
Their surging Status took my breath away, but I did not retreat.
“Are you just going to stand there and watch?”
Instead, I drew out even more of the ‘Status’ that lay dormant within me.
I was a constellation too.
When it came to ‘Status’, I was no less than any of them.
Rrrrrrumble!
A few constellations staggered back under the ‘Narrative-grade’ Status I was emitting. But not all of them did.
[An interesting child.]
At once, several constellations above the canyon bowed and stepped back.
Someone was approaching through their ranks.

With every step he took, his long golden hair scattered in glints of light, and his four arms traced beautiful rainbows. The third eye on his forehead looked down at me like the sun gazing imperiously upon the earth from the heavens.
[I heard Mithra intended to bestow his holy day upon you, and wondered what sort of fellow you might be.]
His appearance, blinding even to look at, spoke for his modifier.
‘Supreme God of Light’.
I even knew his true name.
“Surya.”
Bzzzzzt!
Dazzling sparks flying as I spoke his true name.
A sight that attested to the Status contained in that name.
[Child, do you know my name?]
“I do.”
The nebula <Vedas> had eight great <Lokapalas>.
Gods of the eight directions, including east, west, south, and north.
“Surya of the southwest (南西).”
Surya was one of those eight <Lokapalas>.
[The constellation ‘Mass Production Maker’ frowns.]
[The constellation ‘God of Wine and Ecstasy’ condemns the ‘Supreme God of Light’!]
[The constellation ‘Queen of the Darkest Spring’ points out that the ‘Supreme God of Light's’ conduct is unworthy of his Status!]
A powerful being comparable to one of Olympus's twelve gods.
That being was looking at me.
[Then you must also know that you cannot win this game.]
Faced with the Status of thousands of years pouring from his body, I fought down the urge to step back.
He was not a constellation I could contend with.
The <Lokapala> Surya was a being on an entirely different level from King Oedipus or Cleopatra, who had become constellations after being human.
[Come to <Vedas>. If you continue like this, you will die even if you win this game.]
“I refuse.”
[You do not know what the world beyond a ‘Giant Story’ is like. Do you think you can bear that power and endure alone? It is not a story that a single star can shoulder.]
I knew what he meant.
The world Surya saw was probably different from the world I saw.
Acquiring even a single ‘Giant Story’ completely changed the dimensions of the world a constellation could perceive.
“No, I can shoulder it. Because I'm not alone.”
[The possibility of a new Story is sprouting!]
As though responding to my words, the ‘73rd Demon Realm’ was stirring.
Surya felt the tremors too and spoke.
[Not alone······ How amusing. Who do you have with you now?]
“To hear that from someone who should know the law of causes and conditions (因緣法) better than anyone······ It's laughable.”
Rrrrrrrumble!

Powerful Status began flowing from Surya's incarnation body. Status that made even the surrounding constellations turn pale. But even a ‘great deity’ could not exercise all his power in this game without paying a price.
Bzzzzzt!
Sparks bursting forth in real time flooded the space ahead with dazzling light.
[Melledon] had earned 2 victory points in this game.
With 2 points, Surya might be able to unseal one of his many stigmas.
I couldn't let that happen.
As I moved, constellations blocked my path.
Bzzzzzzt!
My fist, imbued with the power of [Electrification], exploded against the constellations' faces. The [Broken Heart of a Young Gold Dragon] pumped again and again, generating tremendous Magic Power.
Craaaaaack!
I unleashed my power without hesitation.
More, more.
I had to draw out Magic Power to the very limit of my limits.
Boom! Boom! Booooom!
Unable to withstand the power of [Electrification], the constellations were hurled away as bloody pulp.
The power of a transcendent, overwhelming even constellations.
White Pure lightning was burning the constellations' incarnation bodies like thunderbolts.
Gaaaaaaaah!
[Participant ‘Demon King of Salvation’ has killed helper ‘Scorpion Goddess’!]
[Participant ‘Demon King of Salvation’ has killed helper ‘Last Pharaoh’!]

Perhaps the broken Gold Dragon heart could not sustain the Magic Power; the energy throughout my body began rapidly ebbing away. I gritted my teeth and moved. I landed a blow on the charging ‘Duke Bercan’, then immediately turned and struck the ‘Mysterious Bird of the Nile’ with Electrification.
[You have identified too deeply with this individual!]
[Excessive use of Bookmark may cause permanent damage to your soul!]
But even as he watched me approach, the ‘Supreme God of Light’ showed no sign of alarm.
[We have watched you for a very long time. You always borrow the power of ‘other beings’.]
I cloak my body in [Beast King’s Sensitivity] and prepare a strike with [Electrification].
[From the first scenario until now, you have never once fought with ‘your own power’. And you dare believe you can establish a ‘Story’ of your own?]
Booooooom!
[History learned by theft is nothing more than history learned by theft.]
The dismay of striking solid steel.
Using just one of his four arms, the ‘Supreme God of Light’ blocked the [Electrification] strike.
[That is not yours.]
The god's third eye shone as brightly as the sun.
At that moment, I realized which stigma Surya had unsealed.
[The featured constellation ‘Supreme God of Light’ activates the stigma ‘Third Eye’!]
Bzzzzzzzt!
My vision twisted, and all the light around me vanished in an instant. In the darkness, it felt as though the edges of space were slowly crumpling.
[There is no ‘you’ in your Story.]
My surroundings were already Surya's domain.
[You will die alone.]
The power to seize control of space and time wherever the ‘Third Eye’ reached.
That was the authority of Surya's ‘Third Eye’.
I was taken aback, not having expected Surya to use his power so soon.
How could I get out of here?
Electrification wouldn't do it, and even Way of the Wind offered no chance.
[Activating the Story ‘Distorting Things as One Pleases’!]
I couldn't decide which ‘Story’ I should read.
「King of a Kingless World」 wasn't suitable.
「One Who Opposes the Extraordinary」 was questionable too.
The same went for 「One Who Hunted the King of Disasters」.
The space had now shrunk to little more than one pyeong.
What on earth should I do······
[The Story ‘Distorting Things as One Pleases’ screams.]
That was when I felt a sting in my back and heard a crunching sound.
A familiar sound, as though someone were devouring a Story.
「Ve ry deli cious」
A chill ran through me. When I looked back, something like a small mouth was clinging to my back, eating away at my Story.
「Kim Dok ja is an id iot」
It was the ‘Fourth Wall’.
This fucking bastard was getting in my way when it should have been helping?
Torn to shreds, ‘Distorting Things as One Pleases’ was now so damaged it was almost unusable, and was disappearing into the thing's stomach.
The absurdity of the situation made me forget even my sense of urgency, and I shouted.
But what came out of my mouth wasn't a shout.
「The ‘Fourth Wall’ said, “Roa aa aar!”」
Roooooooar!
The sound poured out explosively, crashing straight into the surrounding space. The space shuddered as though it were alive, and enormous cracks opened at the points that had been crumpling.
[The stigma ‘Third Eye’ shudders.]
Craaaaaack!
In that instant, I understood what had happened.
‘Third Eye’ was a mental ability that controlled space and time by manipulating perception.
And my ‘Fourth Wall’ was the strongest skill when it came to mental barriers.
[The constellation ‘Supreme God of Light’ is astonished!]
The darkness shattered all at once, like breaking glass. As the light returned, the first thing I saw was the ‘Supreme God of Light’, bloody tears flowing from the eye on his forehead.
[You······ What are you?]
As his astonished True Voice rang out, the constellations that had briefly faltered charged at me.
[How dare you······ Kill him!]
My Magic Power was exhausted. I didn't even have the strength to open [Bookmark] again.
But I no longer needed to.
Because 20 minutes had already passed since the game began.
[The canyon's fog grows thicker.]
Grooooooooan······
At the eerie cry from somewhere in the canyon, all the constellations stopped moving at once.
Rooooooar!
The moment the tense constellations looked up at the canyon rim, a pitch-black shadow fell over us. With the tension leaving my body, I braced myself against the rock face and slid to the ground.
It had been a very long time since I'd seen something like that.

Five kilometers long. Its body, more than several dozen meters around, was bringing down the canyon rim as it fell toward the ground. The startled constellations cried out warnings, but the larger ones had no time to dodge and were crushed beneath the great monster's scales.
[Helper ‘Mysterious Bird of the Nile’ has been killed by the ‘Apocalypse Imoogi’!]
The monster that had burst the constellations like insects coiled across the entire canyon and cried out into the air.
Roooooar!
[Apocalypse Imoogi].
The name of the monster I had been waiting for.
[Damn it! No one retreat!]
Thrown into confusion by the sudden catastrophe, the constellations began attacking the imoogi with their respective stigmas.
Defeating that ‘monster’ would grant a powerful team buff.
But there was no way they could defeat it.
Booooom!

According to ‘Ways of Survival’, the [Red Dragon of Apocalypse] that had appeared in <Armageddon> possessed the terrifying authority to sweep away a third of the stars in the sky with a single flick of its tail.
[Aaaaaaagh!]
Of course, that imoogi wasn't as powerful as the [Red Dragon of Apocalypse] it was modeled after, but even so, no constellation could take on that monster in the early stages of the game.
[Guuuuurgh!]

Constellations torn apart by the imoogi's teeth fell, spewing Stories, while those swept up by its tail died as their torsos burst. Only the incessant barrage of system messages reported the carnage in the canyon.
In an instant, seven participants and helpers died in the canyon.
Surya and the few other constellations that had barely survived were slipping out of the canyon, their escape made possible by the other constellations' sacrifices.
Surya's cold voice rang through the canyon like an echo.
[You devised a wicked scheme. But you will not escape unscathed either.]

The Apocalypse Imoogi, which had crushed the constellations until they burst, was now looking at me with glowing yellow eyes. A red sphere gathered at its mouth, as though it intended to melt away the last insect. Red Flames of Apocalypse. Flames of judgment said to borrow the fires of hell to melt everything on earth.
Rrrrrrumble!
The plan had been sound.
[Melledon] and [Bercan] had suffered devastating losses, and the game, which had been going against us, was now almost evenly balanced.
······If only I had saved a little strength.
With my death, we would lose our sentence here.
I felt disappointed and hollow.
If it went to a third game······ Would we stand a chance?

As I slowly closed my eyes, the deep red flames spewed by the dragon of apocalypse poured down overhead. A searing wave of heat enveloped my body, and I heard the rocks around me sizzling as they melted. But no matter how much time passed, I did not die.
[A new helper is summoned into the game!]
When I opened my eyes, someone stood in front of me.
A neat commando uniform.
A soldier with a special forces insignia on his shoulder was holding up an enormous shield, blocking the falling flames.
[The constellation ‘Master of Steel’ is looking at you.]
He was a man who had endured even [Hell Flames Ignition], said to be the hottest flames in the world.
“Captain, serving under the Republic of Korea Anti-Large-Monster Special Operations Command······”
Watching the man swallow his trembling words, I let out a sigh.

“How,” or “Why.” I wanted to ask something, anything, but no words came. In the face of the countless voices pouring from the man through [Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint], anything I could say was meaningless.
Then I saw an enormous ‘Chimera Dragon’ descending from the sky.
[A new helper is summoned into the game!]
Rooooar!
Seeing the little girl seated on the dragon's head, I felt, absurdly, as though I might cry a little.
“Ajusshi!”
The helpers Yoo Joonghyuk had called had finally reached the battlefield.
Yoo Joonghyuk had brought in three ‘reinforcements’ in total.
Beast Master Shin Yoosung and Steel Sword Emperor Lee Hyunsung.
“Hyunsung-ssi! Take Dokja-ssi and retreat!”
[Ariadne's Web] shot from the air and fastened me to Lee Hyunsung's broad back. A woman in a catsuit, running through the sky with [Hermes Walking Method].
It was Yoo Sangah, Olympus's incarnation.
“Yoosung, deal damage with its breath from a distance! Keep it up until Hyunsung-ssi gets clear!”
Rooooooar!
When the [Chimera Dragon] roared and unleashed its breath, the Apocalypse Imoogi screamed, apparently in considerable pain.
[The constellation ‘Master of Steel’ allocates a large amount of probability to their incarnation.]
[The constellation ‘Abandoned Lover of the Labyrinth’ supports her incarnation.]
[The constellation ‘Master of the Skywalk’ cheers on their incarnation.]

Given the situation, the constellations supporting Lee Hyunsung and Yoo Sangah seemed to be putting up quite a fight themselves. Under Yoo Sangah's deft command, I was slung over Lee Hyunsung's shoulder and forcibly carried away.
“······Lee Hyunsung-ssi.”
“Please stay still, Dokja-ssi.”
“You don't have to go this far. I can move now too.”
Even at my words, Lee Hyunsung did not loosen the hold of his strong arms. He only kept climbing silently up the canyon.
As the canyon rim began coming into view, Lee Hyunsung spoke.
“Dokja-ssi, have you ever thrown a hand grenade?”
“······A hand grenade?”
“Using a hand grenade requires three steps. Remove the safety clip, remove the safety pin, and throw.”
“I know. I threw one in basic training too.”
“Then you must also know how important a grenade's safety pin is.”
At that moment, I realized what Lee Hyunsung was going to say.
“I once lost a safety pin.”
“······Wasn't it a cartridge case last time?”
“I told myself I would never lose it again.”
Then Lee Hyunsung turned his head and looked at me.
“You must keep the safety pin firmly in place while you still can.”
Before long, we reached the top of the canyon.
Below, Yoo Sangah and Shin Yoosung were riding the [Chimera Dragon] out of the canyon. At Shin Yoosung's radiant smile, my heart swelled before I knew it.
“Hyunsung-ssi.”
In the end, I knew what Lee Hyunsung wanted to say.
Because he had lived his whole life as a soldier, there were things he could only express that way.
“Thank you so much for coming.”
I heard sniffling beside me, but made a point of pretending not to notice. A moment later, something came rolling over like an acorn and bumped softly against my leg.
“Ajusshi!”
The sight of her hugging my tattered legs tight, as though they were something precious.
“It's been a while, Yoosung.”
With her face buried in my coat, Shin Yoosung nodded vigorously. As I gave her back a gentle pat, Yoo Sangah approached from farther away.
“It's been a while, Dokja-ssi.”
“Yes. Have you been well?”
Had she been well? What a stupid question.
No one could be doing well once the scenarios had begun.
“You're still the same, Dokja-ssi.”
Yoo Sangah smiled without pretense. Before the world fell into ruin and after, Yoo Sangah was the only person who laughed at my jokes.
“The others······”
“Only we came for now. Heewon-ssi and the others really wanted to come too, but······”
“I won a coin toss against Lee Gilyoung!”
Shin Yoosung chimed in with a giggle.
I see. So they'd all decided whether I lived or died by tossing coins.
Stroking Shin Yoosung's head, I spoke.
“Thank you, Yoo Sangah-ssi.”
“I'd already been thinking I should come. You got an unfavorable reading from Good or Bad Luck, Disaster or Happiness Fortune, Dokja-ssi.”
“Good or Bad Luck, Disaster or Happiness Fortune?”
Good or Bad Luck, Disaster or Happiness Fortune was a stigma I knew too.
And there was only one constellation on the Korean Peninsula with that stigma.
“Yes, it showed great misfortune (大凶), so Sooyoung-ssi and I were wondering which of us should go when Yoo Joonghyuk-ssi contacted us······”
I thought I had a rough idea of what had happened.

Surely Han Sooyoung and Yoo Sangah hadn't tossed a coin······ Han Sooyoung must have had something to do, so Yoo Sangah had come instead. It seemed Han Sooyoung was doing a good job with the task I'd entrusted to her.
“For the record, Sooyoung-ssi wanted to come too.”
“Ah······ Yes. I see.”
Probably a white lie. She didn't like me.
Booooom!
That was when a thunderous noise erupted from the wooded area.
Caught up in the excitement of seeing my companions again, I'd forgotten the game wasn't over yet. Running toward the woods with them, I asked,
“Were you aware of the situation before you came?”
Yoo Sangah nodded.
“Bihyung gave us a rough explanation.”
Even with ‘Ruler of Amusement’ and the Tanker position, Yoo Joonghyuk's health must have been nearly depleted by now.
The second match would be decided here.
The Chimera Dragon blew out a gust, and the nearby trees all fell with shrieks. As the view opened up, the battlefield where the constellations were fighting fiercely came clearly into sight.
“Yoo Joonghyuk!”
At my shout, Yoo Joonghyuk, surrounded by constellations, looked toward me.
「You're late.」
Still as insolent as ever, but with blood pouring from all over his body, he looked half-dead.
[It's him! He's the one with the sentence!]
One of the constellations shouted toward me; apparently, some of them had special skills.
Excluding our team, six constellations and participants remained in total.
And even with our new reinforcements, we numbered only five.
Besides, Yoo Joonghyuk was already barely able to fight.
[Go!]

As the full-scale battle began, the constellations surged forward in a formation centered on the ‘Founder of Humanity’ and the ‘General of Vanara’. The first to charge against them was Steel Sword Emperor Lee Hyunsung.
“I won't! Lose it! Again!”
Charging as though he were firing his battle cry ahead of him, Lee Hyunsung locked both arms with Manu and began a contest of strength with an actual Narrative-grade constellation.
Bzzzzzt!

Manu frowned as though displeased to be grappling with a mere incarnation. Powerful ‘Status’ blazed from his fingertips, and the steel shell gradually softened, but Lee Hyunsung's expression showed no sign of yielding.
[The constellation ‘Master of Steel’ glares at the ‘Founder of Humanity’.]
Just as the Founder of Humanity was Narrative-grade, so was the Master of Steel.
Rrrrrrrr!
Watching the [Steel Transformation] spikes growing all over Lee Hyunsung's body, I could imagine how punishing the personal scenarios he had undertaken must have been.
This was not a level an incarnation still in scenarios 10 through 19 could reach.
The present Lee Hyunsung was showing a capacity for growth that far surpassed that of Lee Hyunsung in any previous round.
Watching the scene, Yoo Sangah rushed forward too.
“I'll handle Olympus.”
[You bitch, have you lost your mind!]
King Oedipus shrieked when he spotted Yoo Sangah.
Originally, both belonged to the same <Olympus>.
But if what Dionysus had told me last time was true, Olympus was currently in a civil war.
[Master of the Skywalk! You are making the wrong choice!]
I didn't know the exact situation, but it seemed clear that a group led by Hermes and Dionysus was trying to break away from the existing <Olympus>.
As Yoo Sangah began a fierce battle with King Oedipus, wheeling freely through the air, Shin Yoosung set the Chimera Dragon in motion.
Rooooooar!
A concentrated breath attack blanketed the battlefield. Constellations that failed to dodge screamed.
[10 minutes remain.]
Before I knew it, the second match too was racing toward its end.
The teams' victory points were currently almost equal.
That made the constellations desperate too.
Gaaaaah!

As several constellations joined the attack on the Chimera Dragon, it and Shin Yoosung were quickly driven into danger. Perhaps because it had expended so much stamina fighting the [Apocalypse Imoogi] earlier, the dragon wasn't fighting as powerfully as I'd expected.
[Finish it off! Size is all it has!]
A draw in this match would put us at a disadvantage.
The contest would go to a third match, and if we failed to earn victory points there too, we would have to face the constellations on a stage where the penalties were gone.
Knowing that, Yoo Joonghyuk pointed at [Duke Bercan] and spoke.
“Kill the duke. He has the sentence.”
I nodded.
“I'll clear a path.”
Squeezing out his Magic Power, Yoo Joonghyuk unleashed [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] ahead of him.
[They're after the sentence!]

Yoo Joonghyuk slashed and slashed again, carving a path. As the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] traced a great semicircle with the last of his strength and slammed into the ground, the constellations waiting for an opening charged all at once.
「I'm leaving it to you, Kim Dokja.」
With his Magic Power exhausted, Yoo Joonghyuk's heart was pierced by Manu's spear.
[Participant ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ has been killed!]
Even at the moment of his death, he stood straight.

Once Yoo Joonghyuk, who had been blocking their way, vanished, the constellations immediately turned toward me. The Primitive Spear and flash cannon came hurtling in. But neither the spear tip nor the explosions reached me.
Claaaaang!
“Dokja-ssi!”

Lee Hyunsung activated [Steel Transformation] and blocked the constellations' attacks. Though the searing heat and impacts must have been terribly painful, his expression seemed full of vigor instead. In the distance, I could see [Duke Bercan] fleeing.
[5 minutes remain.]
“Hyunsung-ssi, throw me.”
“No. Not that again······!”
“Once a grenade's safety pin has been pulled, you have no choice but to throw it.”
I spoke, looking into Lee Hyunsung's wavering eyes.
“Besides, dying here doesn't mean you really die.”
We would really die if we lost this ‘selection’.
After looking at me for a moment, Lee Hyunsung squeezed his eyes shut, then opened them.
His eyes had become a soldier's once more.
“I cannot believe that lie again!”
“No, now isn't the time to be stubborn―”
“If we die, we die together!”
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ is greatly pleased.]
“We certainly will.”
With those words, Lee Hyunsung began running with me on his back.
Struck by the charging Lee Hyunsung, Manu rolled across the ground like a bowling pin.
[Gurgh! A mere insolent incarnation······!]
No one could stop Lee Hyunsung's rampaging charge.
At least, that was how it looked for a moment.
[Arrogant child. As I said earlier, that paltry ‘history’ will not suffice.]
Kabooom!
The force produced by powerful ‘Status’ made Lee Hyunsung falter.
Surya, the ‘Supreme God of Light’, had recovered his strength and was blocking our way.
Even if he could not properly use [Third Eye], he was a Lokapala of <Vedas>.
He possessed countless authorities that could stop us.
As his four arms moved, the entire ground beneath Lee Hyunsung was pushed back. Ground on which he could run and run, only to keep running in place.
[The place where you now stand is fitting for a human. A human who repeats the same mistakes, that is.]
From Lee Hyunsung's back, I activated the power of [Electrification]. Lightning shot from my swinging fist and struck Surya's torso.
Rrrrrrrumble!
But Surya did not budge.
A transparent barrier formed by his four arms was nullifying every one of my attacks.
[Is this truly all? Do you truly intend to see ‘the end of this scenario’ with so little?]
A power that denied all the history I had built.
Neither [Electrification] nor [White Pure Star Energy] worked.
[How the times have changed. With that paltry ‘history’······]
This was the gap between us with only thirty percent of his power unsealed.
What would happen if a hundred percent were unsealed?
That was when a shrill voice rang out.
“Don't look down on ajusshi!”
Shin Yoosung was shouting from the head of the airborne Chimera Dragon.
Rooooooar!
A breath attack pouring out at Shin Yoosung's signal.
Surya swept an arm and scattered the breath as though it were laughable.
Taking advantage of that opening, Lee Hyunsung leaped.
Booooom!
With [Steel Transformation] activated, Lee Hyunsung's body collided with Surya. For the first time, Surya's body, which had remained unmoved through countless attacks, flinched.
“Aaaaaaaah!”
Lee Hyunsung swung his fists at Surya like a madman. Even as his fists, transformed by [Steel Transformation], split open, spilled blood, and sent broken fragments of bone flying, he did not stop.
Craaaaack.
[The ‘73rd Demon Realm’ responds to your will and that of your helpers.]
[A new Story about you is being created.]
A human's will to challenge a god was cracking that supreme god's defensive barrier.
A small opening.
A minuscule crack created by human history.
“Hyunsung-ssi.”

And Lee Hyunsung and I did not miss that crack. As though throwing a grenade, Lee Hyunsung hurled my body, shrunk through [Miniaturization], with all his might. I broke through the barrier formed by Surya's arms and hurtled straight toward Duke Bercan.
The startled duke turned his head at almost the exact moment I activated [Electrification] and drove my sword into his neck.
[Participant ‘Demon King of Salvation’ has killed participant ‘Duke Bercan’!]
······I did it.

Along with a dizzying sense of victory, countless system messages flowed into my mind. But before I could read them all, a force seized me and crushed me until I burst. In the final moment, I caught a fleeting glimpse of Surya's face.
[You have been killed.]
My vision went dark for an instant, then returned.
It felt like a power outage in my consciousness.
I blinked blankly, but all I could see was a pitch-black ceiling.
······What happened?
After slowly taking a deep breath, I put my sluggish mind to work and began to think.
I had been participating in the second match of the ‘Demon King Selection’.
At the last moment, I'd killed [Duke Bercan], and almost simultaneously, Surya's strike had hit and killed me. I did hear a flood of system messages afterward, but······
Had we won the second match?
Or······ Had we lost?
I thought it over carefully, but couldn't be sure.
[You have seized the enemy's sentence and won the game!]
I thought I might have heard that message.
[Your sentence has been seized, and you have lost the game!]
But I thought I might have heard that message too.
Perhaps it had been both.
If so, which had come first?
For now, I had no way of knowing.
[You have been killed.]
That was the only message I was sure of.
That I had died in the game.
And that I had opened my eyes in this place.
